description: Interface definition for the Creature Engine
purpose: Generates and manages creatures derived from ASH cosmic patterns

methods.name: generate_creature
methods.description: Generate a creature from a cosmic pattern and realm context

methods.name: get_creature_behavior
methods.description: Get the behavior pattern for a creature

methods.name: spawn_encounter
methods.description: Spawn a creature encounter at a location based on active patterns

methods.name: build_creature_manifest
methods.description: Create CreatureManifest and EncounterPlan from ASH provenance.

invariants: All creatures derive from ASH patterns
Creature properties are influenced by realm context
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: creature_manifest
outputs.description: CreatureManifest emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: encounter_plan
outputs.description: EncounterPlan emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: behavior_pressure_vector
outputs.description: BehaviorPressureVector emitted under ASH remediation contract.

ash_remediation_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_remediation_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
